visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian woman with long dark hair, wearing a purple Nike sports bra and high-waisted black leggings, is performing overhead arm stretches on a bright blue outdoor running track. The setting is an urban sports field during the daytime, with green grass in the center and tall city buildings visible under a clear sky. A microphone is clipped to her bra. (2) As she crouches down to tie the laces of her white athletic sneakers, a very muscular Asian man wearing a black tank top and grey shorts approaches her from the back. The camera captures a medium shot of the woman from the side, focusing on her form and the interaction as the man begins to speak to her. (3) The scene transitions to the two main characters running together at a moderate pace along the blue track. A vibrant graphic overlay with the text "PEETA 百人約跑" appears on the screen. The man is now holding two black dumbbells while running, demonstrating the physical challenge discussed in their conversation. The lighting shifts from bright afternoon sun to the cooler, dimming light of dusk. (4) In the final phase, it is night, and the track is illuminated by bright stadium lights. Both characters appear sweaty and physically fatigued. The man, now shirtless, holds a small handheld microphone towards the woman while they conclude their training session. The woman points directly at the camera with a determined expression, holding a white and red towel in her left hand.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a light, rhythmic acoustic guitar melody in a major key at approximately 110 BPM. A male voice introduces himself with a friendly, casual tone and moderate pitch variability, asking "Miss, excuse me, can I run with you?". The sound of distant outdoor wind and very faint city hum forms the ambient noise floor. (2) A sharp, high-pitched "ding" sound effect punctuates a visual transition. The female voice responds with an energetic "Yo!" in a high-pitched, clear tone. The dialogue becomes a back-and-forth exchange with low speech-pause density. As they discuss running, the rhythm of the music becomes more pronounced with the addition of light percussive elements like a drum kit. (3) As the characters begin to run, their voices exhibit noticeable breathiness and vocal strain, indicating physical exertion. The speech rate remains moderate, but the intensity of the female voice fluctuates as she reacts to the challenge. The sound of percussive footsteps on the track surface is clearly audible, mixed with the ongoing upbeat BGM. (4) In the final segment, a "whoosh" transition sound effect leads into a night setting. The BGM remains consistent but slightly lower in volume compared to the vocals. The male voice maintains a dominant, authoritative yet encouraging tone. Both speakers have high vocal arousal and valence, despite the audible physical fatigue in their voices. The audio ends with a clean cut as the music swells slightly.

The video transitions from a playful conversation into a genuine interval training workout at an outdoor track.
